preconditions.expression: head is not None and root is None
preconditions.description: The linked list head must exist and the tree root must be uninitialized (None) at the start of conversion.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node.next is not None])
preconditions.description: Every node value in the linked list must be an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len([node for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node.next is not None]]) == N
preconditions.description: The linked list must contain exactly N nodes, where N is the size of the complete binary tree.

postconditions.expression: all(root is not None and root.val == head.val) or (root is None and head is None)
postconditions.description: The root of the tree must match the first node of the linked list in value if the tree is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is not None and node.left.val == K[2*i+1] if 2*i+1 < N else node.left is None for i, node in enumerate([root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node.left is not None] + [node.right for node in [root] if node.right is not None]))
postconditions.description: For every node in the tree, its left child must match the value at position 2*i+1 in the linked list if it exists.

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is not None and node.right.val == K[2*i+2] if 2*i+2 < N else node.right is None for i, node in enumerate([root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node.left is not None] + [node.right for node in [root] if node.right is not None]))
postconditions.description: For every node in the tree, its right child must match the value at position 2*i+2 in the linked list if it exists.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None or (node.left.val <= node.right.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node.left is not None] + [node.right for node in [root] if node.right is not None])
postconditions.description: The tree structure must adhere to the complete binary tree property where left and right children are filled level by level.
